page.overview:
Who is Jessica Duvall?

Unnamed father † Scott Duvall (brother) Gretchen Duvall † (daughter) Becky Duvall † (sister-in-law) Jack Duvall † (nephew)

Jessica Duvall, was a minor yet crucial character in Invincible. She was the late sister of Scott Duvall, who was killed in the Destruction of Chicago. Her death is the primary reason why her brother targeted Invincible, as he blamed him as much as he blamed his father, Omni-Man, for his role in his sister's death.

Jessica was a woman of a fair build with a brown complexion, short brown hair, and brown eyes.

Prior to her demise, Jessica wore a short-sleeve gray shirt and blue jeans, as well as pearl earrings.
